rationale: Ordinary automatic CUDA semilocal XC uses 1024 SCF and force points without a profile, shape gate or FP64-throughput restriction, applying the 96-atom complete cold/warm winner directly. CPU, numeric resource promises and nonlocal CUDA retain their separate existing schedules. Explicit sizes, scientific controls and bounded 256-point allocation-failure fallbacks remain authoritative. Historical endpoint gains do not imply a universal workload speedup.
revisit_condition: Use complete endpoint and independent-observable evidence to investigate default-path regressions. Preserve explicit SCF inheritance, force overrides, conservative promised capacity and bounded resource-failure retries; do not infer universal performance from the retained 96-atom campaign.
